notes.title: Version 1.2 Released!
notes.content:
[h1]Version 1.2[/h1]

Hello everyone!
This new update has some new gameplay features, customization options, a price drop, and lots of quality of life improvements that people have been requesting. I hope you enjoy!

[h2]Gameplay Changes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Added Steam achievements
[*] Added game tweaks menu to create your own custom game modes
[*] Added ? powerups, which give you a random powerup on pickup
[*] The player now interacts with blue health ores when using ghost powerup
[*] The player now interacts with landmines when using ghost powerup
[*] The invincibility powerup now also reflects enemy bullets
[/list]

[h2]Quality of Life Improvements[/h2]

[list]
[*] Increased the speed of death sequence
[*] Increased the speed of unlock sequence slightly
[*] You can now press the engine button to fast forward the gem get sequence
[*] The overflow powerup now shows "+40" after its pickup text
[*] Brightened up the background of zone 4 in hardmode
[/list]

[h2]Bugfixes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Reduced CPU usage on MacOS
[*] Added missing glyphs in the font
[*] Now shows "key is already bound" error message when trying to bind a taken key
[*] Implemented some new math tricks to make the game's physics more consistent
[*] Falling blocks no longer shake when the game is paused
[*] The annihilate powerup no longer lags the game as badly
[*] Falling blocks will behave more consistently across different framerates
[*] The player's engine sound can no longer play during boss wakeup cutscene
[/list]
